adopt.description: Bind an existing local change to an existing tracker issue, when neither one knows about the other.

flags.name: change
flags.description: change slug (default: derived from the current branch name, e.g. feat/42-change)

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: show what would be written without writing anything

flags.name: force
flags.description: rebind despite an existing, conflicting binding on either side

flags.name: issue
flags.description: issue number to bind the change to (required)

flags.name: openspec
flags.description: path to the openspec/ directory

flags.name: repo
flags.description: target repo as owner/name (default: auto-detect from git remote)

flags.name: store
flags.description: registered OpenSpec store id to operate on (default: openspec/config.yaml `store:`, else ./openspec)

safety_rules: Never hand-edit the marker into an issue body and hope the next sync finds it — marker discovery goes through search indexing, which lags writes by seconds to minutes, and a sync inside that window creates a duplicate issue instead. Use adopt: it writes the ref cache before touching the issue body, so the link holds immediately.
Use -dry-run to preview before adopting
A change already bound to a different issue, or an issue already marked for a different change, is refused without -force
